hooks.command: free=$(df -g /System/Volumes/Data 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==2{print $4}'); if [ "${free:-999}" -lt 100 ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"DISK LOW: only %s GB free - cargo target/ in this repo bloats to 150+ GB. Before heavy builds/tests: du -sh target; if over ~30 GB run rm -rf target/debug (ensure no cargo process is running). See RESUME.md section 6."}}' "$free"; fi; exit 0
